planning_notes: Board must be Arduino Mega 2560 (per target). Circuit wiring must be preserved as provided.

shift595_number is used for both 7-segment digits via sr1->sevseg1 (digit 0, leftmost) and sr2->sevseg2 (digit 1, rightmost). Segment bit order and active_low polarity are taken exactly from extracted electrical facts (active_low=true for A..G).

Buttons btn1/btn2, potentiometers pot1/pot2 use the explicit board endpoint pins from the prompt (btn1=D2, btn2=D3, pot1=A3, pot2=A4). If the physical circuit uses external pull-downs instead of pull-ups, SysML button semantics (pressed=true) and active_high/pullup assumptions may need adjustment.
No explicit wiring for any Serial I/O was provided; therefore serial_channels is empty.
Potentiometer-to-digit mapping (0..99 clamp, tens digit from pot1, units digit from pot2) and pot-to-repeat-speed mapping (0.1..1.0s) are implemented in the SysML model, not in device requests.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Two-digit value (tens from pot1, units from pot2), 00..99; updated on button presses/hold and potentiometer changes

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: btn1: increment button (pressed model=true); behavior handled in SysML

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: btn2: decrement button (pressed model=true); behavior handled in SysML

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: pot1: sets tens digit initial value and increment hold speed (0.1..1.0s) in SysML

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: pot2: sets units digit initial value and decrement hold speed (0.1..1.0s) in SysML

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: delta time since previous control step for button hold and speed-based repeat in SysML

**Task**:
You are tasked with programming an Arduino (uno) to control two 7-segment displays (sevseg1, sevseg2) using two shift registers (sr1, sr2). The displays will show a two-digit number that can be incremented or decremented using two push buttons (btn1, btn2). Additionally, two slide potentiometers (pot1, pot2) will control the speed at which the number increments or decrements when the buttons are held down. The potentiometers will also determine the initial value displayed on the 7-segment displays.

**Detail Rules**:
Initialization: Upon powering on or resetting, the 7-segment displays should show a two-digit number determined by the values of the potentiometers (pot1, pot2). The value of pot1 will determine the tens digit, and the value of pot2 will determine the units digit. The number should be between 00 and 99. The speed of of incrementing or decrementing the number when the buttons are held down is from 0.1 to 1.0 seconds, determined by the value of the potentiometers.

Button Interaction:
1. The first button (btn1) will increment the displayed number by 1 each time it is pressed. If the button is held down, the number will continue to increment at a speed determined by the value of pot1.
2. The second button (btn2) will decrement the displayed number by 1 each time it is pressed. If the button is held down, the number will continue to decrement at a speed determined by the value of pot2.
3. If the number exceeds 99 after incrementing, it should reset to 00.
4. If the number goes below 00 after decrementing, it should reset to 99.
Display Update: The 7-segment displays should immediately update to reflect the new number after each button press or potentiometer adjustment.
